prompt: In the rich, textured style of an oil painting, a sterile hospital corridor unfolds with palpable tension. On the left stands a nurse in crisp blue scrubs, her posture rigid and alert as she holds a clipboard tightly against her chest. Next to her, leaning heavily against the pale wall, is an elderly man in a tweed coat, his shoulders slumped in exhaustion. In the center of the frame, a young woman in a floral dress sits on a hard plastic chair, her head bowed low in quiet despair. Beside her, a small terrier with matted fur rests its chin on her knee, offering silent comfort. To the right, a doctor in a white lab coat gestures emphatically with one hand, pointing toward a closed door at the end of the hall. Standing just behind the doctor is a security guard in a dark uniform, his arms crossed firmly over his broad chest, observing the scene with detached neutrality. The nurse looks directly at the elderly man, creating a line of concern across the space. The young woman reaches out to stroke the terrier, finding solace in the animal's presence. The brushstrokes capture the gleam of the polished floor and the soft folds of fabric, grounding the scene in realism. There is no visible medical equipment such as IV poles or monitors cluttering the hallway, keeping the focus entirely on the human and animal figures within this moment of waiting.
